technical.summary: Multiple moving average bullish alignments and trend structure support upside, but weak ADX, overbought stochRSI, and absent money flow confirmation limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 18 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior members offers minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (343.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 18 days compounds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross, TEMA cross-up, and supertrend bullish alignment provide technical structure support with price near support level (338.213) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 18 days, weak ADX trend confirmation, overbought stochRSI, absent money flow, zero fundamental conviction, and price below 50/200 EMAs create compounding binary risks that outweigh technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure (EMA golden cross, TEMA cross-up, supertrend bullish) and price at support offer defined-risk entry geometry; extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 18 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (343.2), and weak trend confirmation (ADX false, no money flow) create compounding macro and event risks that overwhelm technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish; fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate decisively favors bear case
